title: Chapter 590
paragraphs: Chapter 590
Episode 153. The Purpose of Kinzlo (2)
Jin and his companions momentarily doubted if they had heard correctly.
It was not a word that should come out of the mouth of a strange group known for various acts of terror and schemes until just recently.
Moreover, hadn't Kinzlo not stood by even knowing that Gliek would be released?
As a result, the world was polluted by chaos, and chaos was spreading among living beings.
But purification? They were so astonished that they were momentarily speechless.
"......Purification?"
"Yes, purification! Our Kinzlo aims to beautify the world."
Margiella spoke with a very confident and vibrant voice, regardless of whether her colleagues were shocked or not.
Next to her, Ainas and Bubare nodded as if to say that was it.
'I knew they were crazy, but I didn't expect the whole group to be so deluded.'
Everyone seemed sincere at first glance.
Margiella even imagined a beautiful world due to them and her eyes sparkled.
"It seems the meaning of purification that you think of is a bit different from the universal one we know."
"It might be the same. Have you, Lord Jin, ever thought about it? This world is full of unnecessary pain and contradictions."
"I think about it often. You guys are contributing quite a lot to such an environment."
"You could see it that way for now."
"Some sacrifices and destruction are necessary for essential purification?"
"Exactly!"
"I'll leave the right or wrong of it aside for now, but I wonder how you guys can realize such a utopia."
"The method is not difficult. We are going to extinguish all the gods in the world."
"It's becoming more and more monumental."
"If we extinguish all the gods as planned, our leader will become the only king in the world."
Jin's pupils narrowed.
Extinguishing all the gods... Maybe for Kinzlo, that wasn't an impossible task at all.
As far as Jin knew, the initial creator of the Demonic Stone was Bubare Gaston. Although he cooperated with Zipfel, the core role was played by Bubare.
The reason for the break in the alliance between Kinzlo and Zipfel was because Zipfel had broken the Demonic Stone by using it 'without permission'.
And the Demonic Stone had the function to seal gods and duplicate part of their powers.
"All the Demonic Stones we've seen so far were incomplete. If completed, it's quite possible to go beyond sealing the gods and actually annihilate them."
Jin shrugged his shoulders.
"You and your leader seem to think that the wrongs and contradictions in the world are all the responsibility of the gods."
"Not exactly, but most of it is their responsibility. To describe our grand undertaking in a more magnificent and concise way, it would be a revolution against the gods."
Jin felt a headache coming on.
'Zipfel and Kinzlo. One side wants to become the world's only loser through the power of the gods, and the other side wants to kill all the gods and purify the world... They're all just crazy.'
He gave a hollow laugh at the fact that such entities were in charge of one axis of world power.
'Well, if you look closely, even Runcandel is not much different. They just don't kill or use the gods. They're trying to overthrow Zipfel and become the loser of the world.'
Perhaps the goals of great powers were not so much strange as they were cliché.
It doesn't matter who wants what. The key is whether they have the power to achieve it.
"I've heard your goal. And the reason why humans, dragons, and demons gather in Kinzlo even after hearing such vain dreams. Maybe it's not just because they're stupid..."
Jin paused.
"Hehehe, it tickles, hehe! Sir Ainas!"
"Hehe!"
Seeing Bubare and Ainas laughing and chatting away, he thought that maybe just stupid guys had gathered in Kinzlo.
"...It's probably because of the great power Kinzlo has. Enough to make them believe they can annihilate the gods and purify the world."

During the terrorist attack on the Imperial Palace, the leader of Kinzlo showed transcendent power. Not just physical power, but divine abilities such as teleporting through steel doors or instantly healing a broken Grenil. Moreover, the leader did all these things in an 'incomplete' state.
"What is your leader's identity?"
A demon, a demon king, or a being equivalent to them. Jin's colleagues had speculated the leader's identity in such a way.
Currently, not only the Vamel Alliance, but the whole world is curious about the identity of the leader of Kinzlo.
Since Kinzlo rose as the third power, many people have guessed the identity of the leader, but he remains veiled.
Especially, recently the number of people trying to track down the leader's identity has dramatically increased.
Jin suddenly felt strange about this fact.

'The fact that Kinzlo might have had a way to deal with Gliek during the Imperial Palace attack has not been revealed to the outside world. But why did the number of people looking for the leader's identity increase suddenly after the war ended...'
As his thoughts reached that point, Jin's eyes widened.
'Is it because Zipfel's historical manipulation has weakened since the Imperial Palace incident...!'
The fact that the leader of Kinzlo was also a character influenced by the power of stories had been anticipated during the Imperial Palace terror attack.
-That demon...the face is familiar.
-Are you talking about the leader of Kinzlo?
-Definitely... I've encountered him before. With our... brothers.
-What? You mean you've fought with the brothers of the Demon King clan?
-I'm not sure about that... But I'm certain. I've encountered him...
At that time, Linpa, who was summoned, was sure that he had met the leader of Kinzlo, but he couldn't remember exactly who he was.
It wasn't just Linpa, but Murakan as well.
In the recorded footage left by Solderet, Murakan seemed to have a close relationship with the leader, but he couldn't recognize him.
Margiella smiled.

"Sir Jin may not know this, but actually, you have a deep connection with our leader in many ways. You have received help from the leader several times already. You've even used the leader's item to save your life."
"The leader's item?"
"The White Mirror Luna Runcandel, long ago. The leader must have given you a gift."
Suddenly, his back felt cold.

-Oh, kid, that thing on your neck! Could it be the item of Demon King Orgal? That's right! Wow, you received a precious birthday gift. There must be dozens of kings who risked their lives to obtain that a thousand years ago.
-Who is Demon King Orgal?
-He's a great demon who was active in my time. I can recognize it at a glance. Since the protagonist of that powerful aura gave it to you, it's like you gained another life. Congratulations, kid.
"Demon King Orgal's pendant..."
"Yes, the owner of that pendant is our leader."
Demon King Orgal.
He was the leader of Kinzlo.
Orgal was the original owner of the pendant Jin used and was the lover of Witch Heluram, the person who gifted her the Crimson Gem Dragon Shuri.
He was also the person who stopped Murakan from killing the rampaging Temar in the recorded footage Jin saw.
Contrary to the recorded footage, when he first met Murakan in the present, he said that he was the one who stopped 'Temar trying to kill the rampaging Murakan.'

The contradictions between his words and the recorded footage, the fact that Murakan couldn't recognize him, and the fact that even Murakan and Quikantel, who had been aware of the existence of 'Orgal,' couldn't connect him to the leader of Kinzlo.
Jin intuitively knew that Orgal's history had been manipulated very complexly.

"Or, it could be the contradictions that arose as Orgal resisted the manipulation of Gipil's history. In fact, Orgal was constantly resisting the manipulation of history by Gliek, even before the power of Gipil was weakened.
The reason Murakan and Quikantel recognize Orgal but cannot remember him is also due to this.

"Luna was able to defeat one of the dukes of the demon world and obtained the commander's pendant, which she gave to you. People commonly refer to such things as fate. If our commander had not entrusted that pendant to another person at that time, there would have been no chance for it to fall into your hands."
Jin did not respond to this statement.

"Without Luna's help, you may not have survived. You would have met your death at the hands of Andrei Gipil on that remote island in Bemont. We wouldn't have had the chance to meet and converse like this now!"
His mind was a whirl.
"So, shouldn't you feel a bit grateful to our commander? After all, it was a fate that our commander made."

"Are you saying that Demon King Orgal is such a great entity that he can determine fate? Even if I was able to survive on that island from Andrei thanks to him, it was ultimately for your benefit, not mine."
"Why do you always think in such a twisted way?"
"If I had been absorbed by the Marston stone at that time, Gipil would have possessed the finished product before you."
"Uh... I see."
"The one who saved me that day was Luna, not Orgal. I'd appreciate it if you stop inserting your spoon and spinning tales about determining fate. It's very unpleasant..."
Margiella clapped her hands.
"Did I commit another heinous crime?"
Jin silently took out the machine and blueprint from his pocket again.
Seeing Jin focus on the objects, Bubare, who had been constantly pestering Ainass, turned his attention to the objects as well.

"Jephryn, do you remember what I said in Tikan last time? The discussion about the analysis of the objects should be conducted in front of both sides, and any information that Kinzelo discovers should be shared with us."
Jin intended to be picky and annoying to Kinzelo till the very end.
"Huh, great duke! Did you get caught by something? I feel like we're too submissive!"
"Huh, I remember."
"Proceed as planned. I will give you the opportunity to analyze for three hours. Bubare Gaston, you come forward. The rest should wait at a distance."
Bubare, who was very excited, approached Jin's group with a huff.
Amela and disguised Kwall prepared the workbench, and the three began analyzing immediately.
The officers of Kinzelo had faith in Bubare.
No matter which engineer came, they said, they would not be able to surpass Bubare's ability.
However, as soon as Kwall saw Bubare's analysis, he classified Bubare's engineering knowledge as far below his own and coughed once.
That cough was a signal.
A signal that Kinzelo's side had not recognized the engineering trap that Kwall had set in the objects before coming to the land of the beastmen.
